profile.headline: Strategist · Software Engineer · Writer & Podcaster | Technology, Work, Creativity & Culture
profile.summary:
For most of my career, I've been drawn to the intersection of technology, learning, and the ways people and organizations solve problems.

Whether I'm building software, experimenting with new ideas, mentoring engineers, publishing books, teaching workshops, or helping organizations navigate change, I'm most energized by making complex ideas understandable, useful, and actionable.

Today I work at Northwestern Mutual, where I've expanded my software engineering role into one that embodies technical leadership and experimentation, organizational strategy, developer experience, and enterprise innovation. I've helped shape AI adoption through internal platforms and workflows, presented to executive leadership, mentored engineers, and built tools and programs that help people work more effectively.

But technology has only ever been one part of a broader interest in how people learn, communicate, create, and improve the systems around them. Outside of engineering, I've built and operated a publishing and education business, taught creative writing through the University of Wisconsin's Division of Continuing Studies, spoken at conferences, and published award-recognized books.

I'm particularly interested in ambiguous problems—the ones that don't fit neatly into a job description or existing process. I like understanding the people, systems, and constraints involved, testing ideas, and turning promising approaches into something that actually works.

My areas of interest include:

• Strategy & Innovation
• Experimentation & Problem Solving
• Organizational Change
• Technology & Digital Strategy
• Learning & Education
• Research & Communication
• Technical Leadership
• AI & Emerging Technology
• Product & Developer Experience

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Work spanning software engineering, experimentation, enterprise innovation, organizational strategy, and technical leadership, with a particular focus on helping teams adopt and apply emerging technologies effectively.

- Led the definition, design, and launch of Northwestern Mutual’s enterprise AI Hub, including the NM Skills Library and MCP Registry, supporting scalable experimentation, AI adoption, and developer enablement across multiple engineering organizations and hundreds of engineers. The platform exceeded 1,500 weekly views and 1,000+ skill interactions shortly after launch.

- Led cross-organizational research into AI adoption in partnership with engineering, product, and business stakeholders, identifying opportunities to improve productivity while maintaining human oversight, governance, and software quality.

- Presented enterprise innovation strategy, AI adoption initiatives, and organizational enablement recommendations to executive leadership, including the CEO, helping shape the organization’s approach to emerging technology and AI-assisted software development.

- Authored the organization’s most-downloaded AI skill, contributing more than 15% of platform downloads, and designed AI-assisted workflows that helped engineers work more efficiently while improving consistency, quality, and confidence in software delivery.

- Served as primary mentor for software engineering interns, providing technical guidance, project support, and professional development coaching.

- Regularly mentored junior engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, onboarding support, and career development conversations.

- Co-chaired the Pathways Mentorship Program engagement committee, facilitating multi-campus mentorship and talent development initiatives.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Created a React library of reusable components to streamline implementation of common design patterns and improve consistency across applications.

- Exceeded the organizational goal of 60% unit testing coverage for new applications by achieving 93.9% and 82.7% coverage for the Experience API and front-end application, respectively.

- Shaped the future of mentorship by pitching the Vice President of Engineering on a mentee-pod model designed to stimulate cross-functional professional development.

- Led a team initiative to migrate to the modern enterprise design system.

- Achieved finalist placement in the 2022 Hack for Good Hackathon with an augmented reality project designed to answer common questions experienced by pediatric cancer patients.

- Awarded “Most Innovative” in the 2024 CXE Developer Experience Hackathon for an application that used ChatGPT and internal Slack data to quantify developer sentiment and generate actionable recommendations for improving developer experience over time.

- Modernized client-facing applications through migration toward federated GraphQL and static application architectures.

- Designed and developed the Client Website Owner’s Box, improving engineering ownership visibility and reducing support friction.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Trained engineers on Kubernetes namespace migration to further separate budgetary concerns and improve organizational infrastructure management.

- Managed Node package updates across microapps and microservices to maintain application security and address dependency risks.

- Led an initiative to ensure the team’s repositories satisfied or exceeded organizational security standards.

- Joined an engineering guild to contribute to technical knowledge sharing and continued professional development.

- Founded a company-internal podcast to connect teams and facilitate conversations around pressing technical topics.

positions.title: Author, Educator, Entrepreneur
positions.description:
Independent multidisciplinary operator who has built businesses, designed educational experiences, communicated complex ideas, and managed projects from conception through execution.

- Built and operated a multidisciplinary independent business spanning publishing, education, digital media, branding, web development, and online learning. 
 
- Published multiple award-recognized books while managing editing, production, marketing, distribution, and business operations from concept through publication. 
 
- Grew the Writescast Network podcast to reach tens of thousands of listeners through editorial leadership, content strategy, audience development, and digital media production. 
 
- Designed educational programming, curriculum, and workshops for writers, professionals, and conference attendees. 
 
- Developed and delivered courses and presentations for organizations including UW Continuing Studies, the UW Writers’ Institute, and the Lakefly Writers Conference. 
 
- Presented at conferences and professional events on creativity, communication, publishing, and professional development.
positions.insights: Skills: Writing · Public Speaking · Project Management · Entrepreneurship · Education · Curriculum Development · Content Strategy · Publishing · Product Management · Business Development

positions.title: Co-Owner and Director of Operations
positions.description:
Independent consumer products business combining product development, e-commerce, operations, and community engagement.

- Co-owned and directed operations for a consumer products business, developing operational workflows, financial systems, e-commerce processes, and growth strategies that supported profitable growth and eventual acquisition.

- Generated nearly $20,000 in revenue within 18 months through development and management of the company’s WordPress/WooCommerce e-commerce platform.

- Achieved a 37% profit margin in the company’s second year through disciplined cost management and operational planning.

- Managed financial records, monthly profit-and-loss analysis, and annual financial projections to guide business decisions.

- Developed and implemented social media strategy across Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram to support customer acquisition and brand growth.

- Raised more than $800 for equity-minded nonprofits through a community reinvestment strategy.
positions.insights: Skills: Entrepreneurship · Operations Management · Financial Analysis · E-Commerce · Business Strategy · Digital Marketing · P&L Management

positions.title: Craft Development Chair
positions.description:
- Helped dozens of authors strengthen their manuscripts by hosting monthly craft summits and providing developmental feedback. 
 
- Coordinated with the Events Committee to organize seminars and panels featuring subject-matter experts.
positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Facilitation · Event Planning · Community Outreach

positions.title: Procurement Assistant
positions.description:
- Reduced cost of goods sold by approximately 2% quarter over quarter through procurement and cost-management initiatives. 
 
- Managed purchase orders driven by MRP requirements and internally approved purchase requisitions. 
 
- Maintained approved-supplier records and conducted audits of internal procurement documentation. 
 
- Coordinated the return of non-conforming materials to vendors, supporting quality and supply-chain processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Operations Management · Procurement · Supply Chain Management · Cost Reduction · Vendor Management

positions.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
positions.description: - Prepared regulatory documentation supporting registration of medical devices in international markets, helping ensure compliance with applicable market requirements.

positions.title: International Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
- Collaborated with data management to integrate discount structures into order-entry software, helping align business requirements with system functionality. 
 
- Led a cross-functional project to improve communication and handoffs between International Sales and Technical Support. 
 
- Tested order-entry system updates, including pricing matrices and Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) information, to validate functionality and accuracy before release. 
 
- Completed electronic export documentation and partnered with Regulatory Affairs to maintain compliance with applicable federal and international requirements.

positions.title: International Sales Coordinator
positions.description:
- Created a distributor and OEM evaluation process to improve supplier-distributor relationships and support international business development. 
 
- Integrated enterprise resource management (ERP) software with Excel-based order forms to streamline order intake and reduce manual processing. 
 
- Standardized the order-entry process by creating training walkthroughs and checklists to improve consistency and knowledge transfer. 
 
- Managed international trade documentation, including pro forma invoices and import-compliant commercial invoices, while supporting export compliance requirements. 
 
- Assigned Schedule B classification numbers to company products to support accurate export documentation and regulatory compliance. 
 
- Translated technical and marketing materials from English into Spanish and Portuguese for international markets. 
 
- Implemented an environmentally conscious system to modernize supply-chain tracking and improve operational visibility.
positions.insights: Skills: International Business · Process Improvement Projects · Supply Chain Management · Brazilian Portuguese · Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) · Export Control Compliance · Translation · Spanish Translation

positions.title: Delivery, Supervisor, Assistant Manager
positions.description:
- Redesigned the back-of-house workspace to separate evening dough preparation from peak dinner delivery operations, reducing congestion and allowing both teams to work more efficiently during high-volume periods.

- Identified sustained customer demand for a medium-sized pizza and advocated for its introduction; calculated dough specifications and baking requirements for a new 16-inch pizza while preserving the characteristics of the restaurant’s proprietary dough.

- Reworked back-of-house production processes to support 12-, 16-, and 20-inch dough portions, including new tray configurations and workflows for preparing and managing multiple pizza sizes.

- Progressed from delivery driver to supervisor and assistant manager, taking on increasing responsibility for staff coordination, customer service, production, and day-to-day restaurant operations.

- Coordinated front- and back-of-house operations during high-volume service periods, balancing customer demand, production capacity, delivery logistics, and staffing needs.

- Trained and supported employees across delivery, production, and service functions, helping maintain consistent operations in a fast-paced environment.
